title: PHI-base 5 schema
description: Schema for the CantoStore collection in the MongoDB database of PHI-base 5.

pmid.title: PubMed identifier
pmid.description: The PubMed identifier (PMID) for the publication, prefixed with 'PMID:'.

rangeType.title: Annotation extension range type
rangeType.description: The data type of the range of the annotation extension relation.

rangeDisplayName.title: Annotation extension range display name
rangeDisplayName.description: A display name for the range of the annotation extension relation.

rangeValue.title: Annotation extension range value
rangeValue.description: The value of the range of an annotation extension relation. For ontology terms, the value is the OBO ID of the term; for annotated features, the value is the unique identifier of the feature; for literals, the value is the value of the literal.

relation.title: Annotation extension relation name
relation.description: The name of the annotation extension relation.

strain.title: Host strain
strain.description: The name of the host strain, cell line, cultivar, etc.

species.title: Host species
species.description: The scientific name of the species of the host genotype.

background.title: Host background
background.description: Background mutations of the host genotype.

alleletype.title: Host alelle type
alleletype.description: The type of mutation of the host allele.

expression.title: Expression level
expression.description: Expression level of the alleles in the host genotype.

gene.title: Host gene
gene.description: The gene identifier of the host gene.

allelename.title: Host allele name
allelename.description: The name of the host allele.

phi_id.title: PHI-base 4 ID
phi_id.description: PHI-base 4 identifiers for this annotation. Multiple values are delimited with the pipe character.

conditions.title: Experimental condition term IDs
conditions.description: OBO IDs for experimental condition terms from the PHI-base Experimental Conditions Ontology (PHI-ECO). Multiple values are delimited with the pipe character.

pathogenAlleles.title: Pathogen alleles
pathogenAlleles.description: Allele details for the pathogen genotype.

gene.title: Allele gene
gene.description: The gene identifier of the allele.

alleletype.title: Allele type
alleletype.description: The type of mutation of the allele.

strain.title: Pathogen strain
strain.description: The strain name of the pathogen genotype.

species.title: Pathogen species
species.description: The scientific name of the species of the pathogen genotype.

background.title: Pathogen background
background.description: Background mutations of the pathogen genotype.

pathogenExpression.title: Expression level
pathogenExpression.description: Expression level of the alleles in the pathogen genotype.

phipoId.title: PHIPO ID
phipoId.description: The OBO term ID for a PHIPO ontology term.

goID.title: Gene Ontology term ID
goID.description: The OBO ID for the Gene Ontology term.

goEvidenceCode.title: GO Evidence code
goEvidenceCode.description: The Gene Ontology Evidence code for the annotation.

anyOf.title: Wild-type host genotype identifier
anyOf.description: Identifier for a wild-type host genotype with no genes of interest.

type.title: Pathogen/host role
type.description: Whether the gene is a pathogen or host gene.

_id.title: MongoDB ID field
_id.description: The _id field for the MongoDB document.

$oid.title: MongoDB ObjectId
$oid.description: The encoded ObjectId for the document.

publicationBlock.title: Publication
publicationBlock.description: Details of the publication that this information was curated from. Retrieved from PubMed.

volume.title: Volume
volume.description: The volume number of the journal.

pages.title: Pages
pages.description: The page number or page range of the publication.

issue.title: Issue
issue.description: The issue number of the journal.

n_authors.title: Number of authors
n_authors.description: The number of authors of the publication. Not populated.

authors.title: First author last name
authors.description: The last name of the first author of the publication.

cellularComponent.title: Cellular component annotations
cellularComponent.description: Gene Ontology cellular component annotations applied to this gene.

cellComponentAdditionalInfo.title: Cellular component additional information
cellComponentAdditionalInfo.description: Annotation extensions used to populate the Additional Information subsection of the 'GO Cellular Component' section.

insert_dt.title: Insertion date
insert_dt.description: The date this document was loaded into the database.

gene.title: Gene
gene.description: Details about the gene. Loaded from UniProtKB.

strain.title: Reference proteome strain
strain.description: The strain of the reference proteome linked to the UniProtKB accession.

product.title: Gene product
product.description: The gene product of the gene.

uniqueName.title: UniProtKB accession number
uniqueName.description: The UniProtKB accession number of the protein of the gene.

organism.title: Organism name
organism.description: The scientific name of the organism of the gene.

dbref_gene_id.title: NCBI Gene ID
dbref_gene_id.description: The identifier of the gene from the NCBI Gene database.

ensembl_gene_id.title: Ensembl gene ID

name.title: Gene name

uniprot_id.title: UniProtKB accession number

ensembl_sequence_id.title: Ensembl protein sequence ID

curation_session.title: Curation session ID
